Leftwards Arrow With Stroke Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Leftwards Arrow With Stroke because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+219A, which you can use as ↚ in HTML, \219A in CSS, or type with Alt+8602 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Leftwards Arrow With Stroke is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+219A is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Leftwards Arrow With Stroke has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ↚ or the hex escape ↚.

How to type leftwards arrow with stroke on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 6 0 2 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8602.
  4. Release Alt. The Leftwards Arrow With Stroke character (↚) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type leftwards arrow with stroke on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Leftwards Arrow With Stroke. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Leftwards Arrow With Stroke" and click the character to insert it.

How to use leftwards arrow with stroke in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\219A"; ()
  • Python: \u219A or chr(0x219A)
  • JavaScript: \u219A or String.fromCodePoint(0x219A)
  • JSON: "\u219A"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ↚?

No legacy Alt code exists for Leftwards Arrow With Stroke because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+219A in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ↚ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ↚, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8602 not work?

Alt+8602 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Leftwards Arrow With Stroke?

The Unicode codepoint for Leftwards Arrow With Stroke is U+219A. You can use this value in HTML as ↚, in CSS as \219A, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ↚ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+219A, then click it.
